facts.name: Net Speed
facts.summary: Download and upload speed in the menu bar, and a card with the last two minutes.
facts.description:
Net Speed shows how fast this computer is downloading and uploading right now.

The menu bar item shows both speeds and refreshes every two seconds; click it for each network connection and how much it has moved since the computer started. The desktop card draws the last two minutes as a small graph.

It counts every real connection (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, VPN) and leaves out the computer's own loopback and the virtual bridges containers and virtual machines make. It reads the counters the system already keeps; it sends nothing anywhere.
